title: Firearm Volume 1 #3 November 1993 Ultraverse Malibu Comics - James Robinson
descriptionText: The Firearm Volume 1 #3 November 1993 Ultraverse Malibu Comics is a single issue comic book written by James Robinson and various artists. Set in the Ultraverse universe, the story follows the character Firearm and Edwin Mosley in an adventure within the US Comics tradition. With a colourful style and superhero genre, this comic is a part of the Modern Age era and is a must-have for general audiences who enjoy action-packed superhero stories. A great addition to any comic book collection, this issue is boarded in English language, making it a valuable piece for fans of the genre.
